mapper.select: SELECT e."英作文ID" AS essayId, e."利用者アカウントID" AS userAccountId, e."英検級" AS level, e."題" AS titleJa, e."題_中国語" AS titleZh, e."設問文" AS questionText, e."作文本文" AS essayText, e."語数" AS wordCount, e."状態コード" AS stateCode FROM public."ENG_英作文情報" e WHERE e."英作文ID" = #{essayId}

SELECT i."英作文画像ID" AS imageId, i."画像区分" AS category, i."表示順" AS orderNo, i."保存ファイル名" AS savedFileName, i."相対パス" AS relativePath, i."MIMEタイプ" AS mimeType, i."ファイルサイズ" AS fileSize FROM public."ENG_英作文画像情報" i WHERE i."英作文ID" = #{essayId} ORDER BY i."表示順", i."英作文画像ID"
mapper.update: UPDATE public."ENG_英作文情報" SET "設問文" = #{questionText}, "作文本文" = #{essayText}, "語数" = #{wordCount}, "更新元コード" = 'BATCH', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "英作文ID" = #{essayId}
UPDATE public."ENG_英作文情報" SET "題" = #{titleJa}, "題_中国語" = #{titleZh}, "更新元コード" = 'BATCH', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "英作文ID" = #{essayId}
mapper.select: SELECT g."添削ID" FROM public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" g WHERE g."英作文ID" = #{essayId} AND g."状態コード" IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY g."添削ID" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT g."添削ID" FROM public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" g WHERE g."状態コード" = 'QUEUED' OR (g."状態コード" = 'RUNNING' AND COALESCE(g."開始日時", g."登録日時") < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{staleMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute')) ORDER BY g."添削ID" ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT g."添削ID" AS gradingId, g."英作文ID" AS essayId, g."回数" AS round, g."状態コード" AS statusCode, g."英検級" AS level, g."題_日本語" AS titleJa, g."題_中国語" AS titleZh, g."設問文" AS questionText, g."作文本文" AS essayText, g."語数" AS wordCount, g."登録者アカウントID" AS userAccountId FROM public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" g WHERE g."添削ID" = #{gradingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" SET "状態コード" = 'SUCCEEDED', "総合得点" = #{score}, "満点" = #{maxScore}, "添削結果JSON" = CAST(#{resultJson} AS jsonb), "AI呼出履歴ID" = #{callLogId}, "失敗理由" = NULL, "終了日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "添削ID" = #{gradingId}
UPDATE public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" SET "状態コード" = 'FAILED', "失敗理由" = #{reason}, "終了日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "添削ID" = #{gradingId}
mapper.select: SELECT g."添削ID" AS gradingId, g."回数" AS round, g."状態コード" AS statusCode, g."総合得点" AS score, g."満点" AS maxScore, g."失敗理由" AS failureReason FROM public."ENG_AI添削履歴情報" g WHERE g."添削ID" = #{gradingId}
